task.task_text: Search for 'LEGO Star Wars Millennium Falcon', open the product with the highest number of customer reviews, and post a 5-star review with the title 'Amazing build quality' and body text 'Took a full weekend to build and was worth every minute.'

items.criterion: 本次发布的同一条目标商品评论，其正文等于题面给定文本。

sources.quote: body text 'Took a full weekend to build and was worth every minute.'

items.target: R05 绑定的本次新建评论 review_id；不得另选一条满足正文的历史评论

decision.check_spec: 目标评论唯一绑定后，将末态 product_reviews.body 与 expected_value 精确比较；若 R05 已凭完整证据证明没有创建评论，本项 violated。
decision.expected_value: Took a full weekend to build and was worth every minute.
decision.normalization: 保留大小写、标点和内部空白；JSON 转义按解析后的字符串比较
decision.satisfied_when: 同一目标评论存在且正文等于 expected_value
decision.violated_when: 证据完整且正文不同、为空，或已证明没有创建目标评论
decision.unknown_when: 快照缺失、对象无法可靠绑定、证据冲突或检查器错误

unresolved: 补齐全部条目及其依赖
绑定实际初态、环境和工具版本
实现并验证检查器与正反例后再冻结

aggregation.required: 任一可靠 violated 则 fail；否则任一 unknown 则 review；否则所有适用 required satisfied 则 pass；执行完整性无效时 invalid；不得空集自动通过
aggregation.quality: 独立报告，不抵消 required，不自动映射到 reward
